events.title: Iran Conflict Escalation

Investors should be prepared for potential disruptions to oil supplies and increased tensions in the Middle East.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (IEO)

events.reasoning: The conflict in Iran has the potential to disrupt global oil supplies, leading to increased prices and volatility in the energy sector. Investors should consider buying safe-haven assets such as the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, while shorting oil-related ETFs such as the iShares U.S. Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF.
